name: Security Center
author: tug-benson
description: Unified security posture dashboard for Omarchy — Lynis hardening index, ClamAV detections, UFW firewall rules, RKHunter warnings and systemd exposure with a global indice (0-100) and per-finding exceptions.

barWidget.description: Global indice in the bar. Click for Lynis, ClamAV, UFW, RKHunter and systemd panels with CVE ticker, collapsible details and one-click scans.

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the engine re-reads logs in the background. The panel refreshes faster while open.

schema.label: Show CVE feed
schema.description: Fetch the latest CVEs from cvefeed.io (network request, can be disabled offline).

schema.label: ClamAV scan paths
schema.description: Comma-separated paths offered as one-click scan shortcuts. Paths are user-writable; no sudo is used for the scan itself.

schema.label: Lynis: show all suggestions
schema.description: When off, only warnings are shown first. Turn on to also list suggestions.
